issue.title: [yang-models] aaa login should verify valid input

failure.body:
#### Description
Invalid AAA login value should fail to apply from yang verification.
Same input is restricted from CLI `sudo config aaa`

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. `apply-patch` invalid input to configDB
2. action succeed
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
```
admin@vlab-01:~/tacacs$ cat login_only.json
[
 {
  "op": "add",
  "path": "/AAA",
  "value": {
   "authentication": {
    "login": "localllllllll"
   }
  }
 }
]

admin@vlab-01:~/tacacs$ sudo config apply-patch -i /FEATURE -i /QUEUE -i /SCHEDULER login_only.json
Patch Applier: Patch application starting.
Patch Applier: Patch: [{"op": "add", "path": "/AAA", "value": {"authentication": {"login": "localllllllll"}}}]
Patch Applier: Getting current config db.
...
Patch Applier: The patch was sorted into 1 change:
Patch Applier:   * [{"op": "add", "path": "/AAA/authentication/login", "value": "localllllllll"}]
Patch Applier: Applying 1 change in order:
Patch Applier:   * [{"op": "add", "path": "/AAA/authentication/login", "value": "localllllllll"}]
Patch Applier: Verifying patch updates are reflected on ConfigDB.
Patch Applier: Patch application completed.
Patch applied successfully.

admin@vlab-01:~/tacacs$ show aaa
AAA authentication login localllllllll
AAA authentication failthrough False (default)
AAA authorization login local (default)
AAA accounting login disable (default)

```

#### Describe the results you expected:
localllll is not valid input and should not pass yang validation.
```
admin@vlab-01:~/tacacs$ sudo config aaa authentication login localllllllll
Usage: config aaa authentication login [OPTIONS]
                                       [[radius|tacacs+|local|default]]...
Try "config aaa authentication login -h" for help.

Error: Invalid value for "[[radius|tacacs+|local|default]]...": invalid choice: localllllllll. (choose from radius, tacacs+, local, default)

```
